info.name: Gestion des membres
info.summary: Let site owners add or remove members in the groups delegated to them — and nothing else.
info.description:
**Restricted member management for Nextcloud.**
A site owner (a person who manages client folders) can only **add or remove members** in the groups they are entitled to manage. The app gives them autonomy without ever letting them create, edit or delete accounts.
**Groups managed automatically:** - groups delegated by an administrator (`occ memberadmin:grant`), and/or - groups for which the user is a Nextcloud **group admin**.
**Workflow:** 1. The administrator creates the accounts and the project groups (local groups). 2. The site owner shares a team folder once with a group. 3. Adding a new client/internal person = adding them to the group — access follows automatically. 4. Removing a member = removing them from the group.
**Security properties:** - Every request is authorized (non-delegated group → 403). - The `admin` group can never be managed. - A user can never remove their own account. - CSRF is enforced on state-changing calls. - Only member add/remove is exposed — no user create/edit/delete. - Works with local groups (accounts may come from LDAP/AD or OIDC/Azure; AD-synced groups are read-only).
**Languages:** interface follows the user's Nextcloud language preference (English / French).
info.author: MemberAdmin
